title: Swatch filter component audit
purpose: Audit swatch as a visual option component with fallback and selection contracts.
objective: Define swatch anatomy, visual data behavior, color/image fallback, selected ring, label strategy, states, responsive behavior, and customization backlog.
scope_boundary: In scope: swatch visual, label, selected ring, color/image support, fallback, size/shape, tooltip/label strategy, states, and QA scenario. Out of scope: checkbox, radio, chips, toggle, and implementation.
entry_condition: TASK-FC-001 has classified preset/widget setting ownership and current swatch render/CSS/parser files are available.
exit_condition: A swatch audit sheet exists with visual fallback and customization controls prioritized.
completion_criteria: Color/image visual parsing and fallback are documented.
Selected ring and state behavior are documented.

phases.title: Anatomy
phases.purpose: Map swatch render, parser, and CSS.

acceptance_criteria: No plugin source changes are made.
